coverage_note: Bounded primary-source inventory for selected treaty, energy-transition, finance and implementation records. This is a discovery and review ledger, not an exhaustive history, commitment comparison, measurement or determination of project applicability. PDF page locators count physical pages from one, including covers.
review_method: Primary documents were examined through browser-extracted text. Direct HTTP requests returned challenge HTML instead of the intended source documents. Original document bytes were therefore unavailable for authentication: retrieved_at, content_sha256 and hash_basis remain null. as_of records the review checkpoint, not source publication or successful byte retrieval.
rights_note: Public reachability does not establish redistribution rights. This inventory contains source metadata, locators and brief paraphrases, without publisher document bodies or a licence claim.
coverage_gaps: Intervening COP/CMA decisions, treaty amendments, ratification and withdrawal status, country NDCs and national implementing measures were not comprehensively reviewed.
Only the sections named in each read_coverage entry were reviewed; other sections and linked documents remain unreviewed.
COP30 coverage selects one final implementation decision and its advance-version discovery index; it does not cover the complete package.
COP31 is ongoing at the checkpoint. Negotiating drafts and final substantive outcomes are not catalogued or asserted; a separately listed adopted agenda establishes only procedure.
No source in this inventory independently demonstrates expenditure, disbursement, delivered capacity, emissions reduction or compliance by a particular entity.

sources.title: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
sources.document_date_basis: The cover gives 1992 without a publication day; the closing clause separately dates the treaty to 9 May 1992.

read_coverage.note: Reviewed the objective, selected inventory/programme/technology provisions and date clause through extracted primary text. Remaining articles and annexes were not systematically reviewed.

sources.summary: Establishes a climate framework and differentiated national commitments concerning emissions inventories, mitigation/adaptation programmes and technological cooperation.
limitations: National circumstances qualify the selected provisions; this entry does not determine obligations for a company or project.
Current participation, amendments and implementation evidence were not assessed.
Direct retrieval supplied challenge HTML; no original-byte receipt or hash is claimed.

sources.title: Kyoto Protocol
sources.document_date_basis: Date in the treaty's closing execution clause; not a separately verified HTML publication date.

locators: Annex A and Annex B headings
read_coverage.note: Reviewed the original first-period commitment clause, execution date and annex headings in official HTML. Other provisions and annex entries were not systematically reviewed.

sources.summary: Provides the original quantified emissions commitment framework for relevant Annex I Parties, with assigned amounts linked to annexed commitments.
limitations: The original first commitment period is historical; later amendments, subsequent periods and present participation were not evaluated.
Annex references do not establish current national or project obligations.
Direct retrieval supplied challenge HTML; no original-byte receipt or hash is claimed.

sources.title: Paris Agreement
sources.document_date_basis: The publication carries a 2016 copyright year without a day; its introduction separately records adoption on 12 December 2015.

locators: Publication and adoption information, PDF pages 2-3
read_coverage.note: Reviewed collective aims, selected nationally determined contribution provisions and adoption/publication metadata. The accompanying COP decision and remaining treaty provisions were not systematically reviewed.

sources.summary: Sets collective climate aims and a framework for successive nationally determined contributions and domestic mitigation measures, retaining differentiated national circumstances.
limitations: Country-specific contributions, participation, implementation rules and delivery evidence require separate sources.
Collective aims do not alone specify a company's measurable duty.
Direct retrieval supplied challenge HTML; no original-byte receipt or hash is claimed.

sources.title: Glasgow Climate Pact: decision 1/CMA.3
sources.document_date_basis: Distribution date on the final session-report cover; the decision's closing plenary line separately records adoption.

locators: Report cover and contents, PDF page 1
Decision 1/CMA.3 closing plenary line, PDF page 10
read_coverage.note: Verified the energy paragraph and adoption date against the final report. Other decisions and annexes in the report were not systematically reviewed.

sources.summary: Calls for faster low-emission energy deployment, efficiency, reduced unabated coal use and removal of inefficient fossil-fuel subsidies, with national-circumstance and transition-support qualifiers.
limitations: The selected paragraph is not a universal deadline or an entity-specific compliance assessment.
No implementation outcome is established by adoption alone.
Direct retrieval supplied challenge HTML; no original-byte receipt or hash is claimed.

sources.title: First global stocktake: decision 1/CMA.5
sources.document_date_basis: Distribution date on the final session-report cover; the decision's closing plenary line separately records adoption.

locators: Decision 1/CMA.5 closing plenary line, PDF page 21
read_coverage.note: Reviewed the selected energy-transition passages, their national-contribution framing and the adoption line. Remaining stocktake sections and other decisions were not systematically reviewed.

sources.summary: Sets collective energy-transition directions involving renewables, efficiency and fossil fuels while preserving nationally determined contributions and differing national circumstances.
limitations: Global capacity ambitions are not annual generation measurements or individual plant duties.
Country contributions and delivered results are not established by this decision alone.
Direct retrieval supplied challenge HTML; no original-byte receipt or hash is claimed.

sources.title: Climate-finance goal: decision 1/CMA.6
sources.document_date_basis: Distribution date on the final session-report cover; the decision's closing plenary line separately records adoption.

locators: Decision 1/CMA.6 closing plenary line, PDF page 6
read_coverage.note: Reviewed the distinct finance goal and broader scaling call, source/contributor qualifiers and adoption line. Remaining finance provisions and other decisions were not systematically reviewed.

sources.summary: Distinguishes an all-actor finance scaling call from the developed-country-led collective finance goal, retaining mixed funding sources and contribution qualifiers.
limitations: Goals do not demonstrate actual disbursement or funding awarded to a named project.
Different finance aggregates must not be treated as the same metric or as entirely public grants.

sources.title: Mutirao implementation decision: 1/CMA.7

Decision 1/CMA.7 closing plenary line, PDF page 8
